title: OpenAI hits back at Apple's lawsuit — and says it has receipts
excerpt: OpenAI responded to Apple's July complaint about stealing trade secrets and called the lawsuit "careless" and "aggressive."
content_html:
OpenAI says Apple got some of its facts wrong — and says it has the receipts to back it up.

In a Tuesday blog post, OpenAI called Apple's July complaint against it a "careless, aggressive and oddly personal lawsuit."

OpenAI also said Apple had made mistakes when it earlier contacted the AI lab about its concerns, including "emailing the wrong person after confusing two Asian last names."

Last month, Apple filed a suit against OpenAI, accusing it of stealing trade secrets using a "coordinated pattern of misconduct at an institutional level." Apple said that a former employee who joined OpenAI exploited an authentication bug, that OpenAI asked Apple engineers to bring in proprietary hardware during job interviews, and that OpenAI leadership "normalized" such conduct.

OpenAI denied wrongdoing at the time and said that it was not interested in Apple's trade secrets. Neither company immediately responded to a request for comment from Business Insider.

In Tuesday's post, OpenAI shared what it said were copies of email correspondence showing that Apple's outside counsel mistakenly sent OpenAI's general counsel a follow-up that had been intended for a former Apple employee.

"Apple had claimed that they contacted OpenAI in February and that we didn't respond," OpenAI wrote in its blog post. "They now admit that their outside lawyers emailed the wrong person after confusing two Asian last names—only after we brought this to their attention."

OpenAI added that "Apple also claimed they had a discussion with our General Counsel, which they now concede never happened."

In its lawsuit, Apple alleged that OpenAI benefited from confidential information taken by former Apple engineer Chang Liu and former design executive Tang Tan.

OpenAI said in its blog post that Apple now concedes that Apple employees reached out to Liu, not the other way around.

OpenAI published what it said were messages between Liu, who now works for OpenAI, and former Apple colleagues. They show Apple employees asking him to help locate files and answer technical questions after his departure on January 22.

"This is a common issue with Apple which is caused by them failing to properly manage system access when people leave," OpenAI wrote in its blog post. "Former employees who are trying to do the right thing when they leave still have access to Apple files—despite not wanting them or even being aware of them."

The messages also show Liu helping with file transfers around his departure and subsequently answering questions about Apple projects.

On Monday, Apple asked a US judge for a court order that would stop Liu, Tan, OpenAI, and io Products from accessing or disclosing its proprietary information as its trade secrets case proceeds. It also sought expedited depositions of Liu and Tan, and two other OpenAI employees who previously worked at Apple.

OpenAI's response is the latest escalation in what was one of Silicon Valley's most high-profile AI partnerships. The relationship frayed after OpenAI accelerated its consumer hardware efforts by hiring former Apple talent, including Jony Ive, the iPhone maker's ex-chief design officer.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 表示，苹果公司的一些事实是错误的，并表示它有证据支持这一说法。

OpenAI 在周二的博客文章中称苹果 7 月份对其提出的投诉是“粗心、咄咄逼人且奇怪的个人诉讼”。

OpenAI 还表示，苹果早些时候就其担忧联系人工智能实验室时犯了错误，包括“混淆了两个亚洲姓氏后向错误的人发送了电子邮件”。

上个月，苹果公司对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其利用“机构层面的协调不当行为模式”窃取商业机密。 苹果表示，加入 OpenAI 的一名前员工利用了身份验证漏洞，OpenAI 要求苹果工程师在面试期间携带专有硬件，并且 OpenAI 领导层“规范”了此类行为。

OpenAI 当时否认有不当行为，并表示对苹果的商业机密不感兴趣。 两家公司均未立即回应《商业内幕》的置评请求。

在周二的帖子中，OpenAI 分享了据称是电子邮件通信的副本，显示苹果的外部法律顾问错误地向 OpenAI 的总法律顾问发送了一份本来是为前苹果员工准备的后续文件。

OpenAI 在其博客文章中写道：“苹果公司声称他们在 2 月份联系了 OpenAI，但我们没有做出回应。” “他们现在承认，在我们提请他们注意此事之后，他们的外部律师在混淆了两个亚洲姓氏后向错误的人发送了电子邮件。”

OpenAI 补充道，“苹果还声称他们与我们的总法律顾问进行了讨论，但他们现在承认这从未发生过。”

苹果在诉讼中声称，OpenAI 受益于前苹果工程师刘畅和前设计主管唐坦获取的机密信息。

OpenAI 在其博客文章中表示，苹果现在承认苹果员工曾向刘进行过接触，而不是相反。

OpenAI 发布了据称是目前在 OpenAI 工作的刘和苹果前同事之间的信息。 照片显示，1 月 22 日他离职后，苹果员工请求他帮助查找文件并回答技术问题。

OpenAI 在其博客文章中写道：“这是苹果公司的一个常见问题，是由于他们未能在人们离开时正确管理系统访问而造成的。” “那些在离职后试图做正确事情的前员工仍然可以访问苹果文件——尽管他们不想要这些文件，甚至不知道它们。”

这些消息还显示，刘在离职期间帮助传输文件，并随后回答了有关苹果项目的问题。

周一，苹果公司要求美国法官发布一项法院命令，阻止 Liu、Tan、OpenAI 和 io Products 在其商业机密案件审理过程中访问或披露其专有信息。 它还寻求加快刘和谭以及另外两名曾在苹果工作过的 OpenAI 员工的证词。

OpenAI 的回应是硅谷最引人注目的人工智能合作伙伴关系之一的最新升级。 在 OpenAI 通过聘请前苹果人才（包括 iPhone 制造商前首席设计官 Jony Ive）加速其消费硬件业务后，这种关系出现了紧张。
